desktop-page.html:
Kainbu

Projects

Kainbu

The launch brief

A smaller, better Kainbu website.

A place for our work to speak for itself. Clear writing, useful details, and nothing that gets in the way.

What we’re making

A new home for Kainbu — a calm place to organize tasks, notes, and the work around them.

The approach

  • Lead with the work, and give it room.

  • Keep the story close to the details.

  • Make the next step clear on every screen.

Before we go live

  • Agree on the brief

  • Collect the references

  • Finish the homepage and navigation

  • Read every line out loud

  • Check the small screens

A little less to look at. A little more to notice.
